reasoning: On the season so far the Timberwolves are the stronger team; with home court the Timberwolves start about 3 points better, in a game of about 227 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Timberwolves win 59 times in 100, by about 3; most games like this end between 202 and 251 total points.

analyst.text: This is the second game of a two-night set in Minneapolis, so both teams know each other inside out and the loser of Monday's game gets an instant revenge spot. Micah Nori, Finch's former top assistant, is facing his old staff twice in two nights, while Minnesota are still without Anthony Edwards. Portland are also still waiting on Ja Morant's return from a hamstring strain. Read Monday's result first; the angle tilts towards whichever side lost it.
